question: What practice should be performed to gain knowledge of the ear and other faculties?
premises: An injunction to perform is given
The mantra of consciousness is involved
Knowledge of the ear and other faculties is the aim
inference: One should indeed practice that mantra of consciousness to attain knowledge of the ear and other faculties.
plain_english: One should indeed perform that; the mantra of consciousness yields knowledge of the ear and the other faculties.
